name: firn_script_clients_direct_json_and_messagepack
commands: local s='a'..string.char(0)..'b'; local p=cmsgpack.pack({1,-1,true,false,s}); redis.call('SET',KEYS[1],p); return redis.call('GET',KEYS[1])
local p=cmsgpack.pack('a',2,'z'); local offset,a=cmsgpack.unpack_one(p,0); local last,b,c=cmsgpack.unpack_limit(p,2,offset); return {offset,a,last,b,c}
